hypothesis: The source-complete phase-selective dual-cache mechanism can execute through the pinned full Gemma forward path with exact stock pre-verification and post-accept reference behavior, preserve mirrored cache ownership, retain positive net target-cycle timing, and expose a measurable quality-unsafe c32 endpoint cost reduction.

identity_assertion.method: Mechanically extracted from the named content-addressed authoritative inputs before activation.

invalid_attempt.reusable_evidence: The synthetic attention-only adapter may be reused for launcher and cache-ledger mechanics, but its timing is not campaign evidence and none of the unproven full-model gates are settled.

bench.reuse_contract: Claim the registered available bench atomically and read its current connection identity from runtime/gpus.json. Reuse its resident exact checkpoint, pinned image/source, compiler, and CUDA caches. Do not provision, recreate, drain, or mutate provider lifecycle.

execution.first_action: Claim the named bench and replace only the attention-only synthetic adapter boundary with a pinned full Gemma forward adapter in the retained mutable environment; do not add another offline readiness gate.
component_sequence: Run pinned full-model stock prefill and ordinary decode with the real checkpoint and production row ownership.
Populate both stock-global and proxy-local shadow KV banks at converted layers 11, 23, 35, 47, and 59.
Replay one captured 384-row depth-12 TARGET_VERIFY graph through the full layer stack.
Mirror one deterministic accepted-index move/free pattern across both banks.
Run the next stock full-model decode and compare against an eager dual-cache full-model reference.
Measure gross target-cycle time and every shadow projection, write, move, dispatch, and synchronization cost with profiler-off CUDA events.
execution.conditional_endpoint: Only if every component exactness, ownership, graph, and positive-net gate passes, run one contemporaneous exact-c32 stock/candidate endpoint pair using the bound 32 x 4,214 x 358 workload. Preserve raw request rows, failures, usage and cache accounting, timing, token IDs, finish reasons, and a cheap coherence sanity check. This is a quality-unsafe performance proxy; token equality is not expected and deployability is forbidden.
execution.repair_policy: Ordinary import, path, container, source-binding, graph-capture, telemetry, and adapter defects are recoverable within the same claim. Preserve settled inputs and rerun only incomplete producer steps. Do not replay a completed valid component or endpoint arm.

required_component_gates: The full-model stock control uses the pinned checkpoint, runtime image, exact c32 row geometry, and production forward symbols.
Stock prefill and pre-verification ordinary decode are exact to the pinned full-model control.
All 384 logical TARGET_VERIFY rows use the proxy only at converted layers; padded rows allocate and write no cache slot.
Stock and proxy banks undergo identical allocation, write, accepted-index move, and rejected-row free operations.
The post-accept stock full-model decode is finite and exact against an eager full-model dual-cache reference.
CUDA-graph replay neither recaptures nor introduces host synchronization.
Gross target-cycle saving minus all shadow maintenance and dispatch costs is positive.

Return infrastructure_terminal only when the full-model component remains scientifically unconsumed at the hard release deadline; do not convert missing evidence into a negative physical bound.

Do not claim quality preservation or deployability, train, alter checkpoint values, replay permanent 55-local/5-global placement, or weaken cache and reference gates.
